Glomerular hematuria is evidence-defined rather than disease-name-defined; pyelonephritis/GU-TB are not glomerular-source diseases merely because they can cause hematuria.

Preserve the Study three-test recognition list while separating capability: radionuclide renography is dedicated quantitative split-function; CTU/IVU mainly provide anatomic/excretory and side-to-side information.
Original PDF resolves formal CKD G staging as the GFR axis; historical Scr values are an older merged-cell phase-adjunct row, not five independent thresholds.
Scr >265 remains Study Precision only, not a universal ACEi/ARB contraindication; Current Core uses indication plus post-start creatinine/eGFR, potassium, BP/volume and reversible-cause assessment.
Current Core uses clinical KRT indications; historical Cr/BUN numbers and severe-AKI-PD exclusion remain Source Precision only.
Historical CKD BP targets remain 306 Source Precision rather than immutable Current clinical targets.
Keep >=10^5 CFU/mL as the classic clean-voided ASB/source anchor with sex-specific persistence confirmation; do not turn it into a universal symptomatic-UTI gate.
Preserve ASB management mainline: pregnancy and mucosa-traumatizing urologic procedures are treatment groups; routine treatment debt is not created for common nonbenefit groups.
Aminoglycoside toxicity risk retained while blanket 'UTI never uses aminoglycosides' removed from Current Core.
WBC casts are high-value support for renal involvement, not a required finding in every pyelonephritis case.
Male=complicated, 3d/7d/2w/6w/6mo regimens, chronic >6 months and IVU gold-standard labels remain explicit 306 Source Precision rather than timeless Current mechanism.
